map.酸价 AV(mg KOH/g) = V×c×56.1 / m；过氧化值 POV(: Acid value AV (mg KOH/g) = V × c × 56.1 / m; peroxide value POV (g/100g) = (V₁ − V₀) × c × 1000 / m, where V is the titration volume, c the concentration and m the sample mass.
map.酸价：滴定 2.50 mL、0.1000 mol/L NaOH、样品 5.00: Acid value: titrating 2.50 mL of 0.1000 mol/L NaOH with a 5.00 g sample gives AV = (2.50 × 0.1000 × 56.1)/5.00 ≈ 2.81 mg KOH/g (passes the ≤3 limit). Peroxide value: blank 0.20, sample 12.50 mL at 0.0020 mol/L, 5.00 g gives POV = (12.30 × 0.0020 × 1000)/5.00 ≈ 4.92 g/100g.
